normative_extracts.spec_section: Section 4: The Prioritized Task Scheduling API
normative_extracts.quote: scheduler.yield() allows a long-running task to yield control to the event loop so higher-priority user input and rendering tasks can execute before resuming.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: A 31-bit lane bitmask prioritizes updates while a linked-list fiber loop checks frame deadlines every unit of work, yielding to input events and preempting low-priority renders.

production_failures.symptom: Input lag on search box despite using debouncing
production_failures.root_cause: Filtering a 3,000-row list synchronously on the SyncLane blocks the main thread for >120 ms per keystroke.
production_failures.mitigation: Keep input value updates on SyncLane and wrap the expensive list state update in startTransition (TransitionLane).

production_failures.symptom: UI tearing between header badge and list items
production_failures.root_cause: An external store mutates while a TransitionLane render is yielded mid-tree, causing post-yield components to read newer data.
production_failures.mitigation: Subscribe to external mutable stores via useSyncExternalStore to force consistent snapshots.
